Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Work in a modern warehouse with an international team. You will pick, pack, and ship customer orders correctly and on time.

No warehouse experience? That's okay! If you are motivated, willing to learn, and like to stay active, we will train you and help you grow.

Please note: This is an active, physical job. You'll be walking, standing and moving throughout your shift.

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you can work in different departments.

Order Picking

- Pick products using a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.
- Make sure orders are complete.

Packing

- Scan products.
- Check orders before shipment.
- Print shipping labels.

Returns

- Inspect returned products.
- Decide whether products can be returned to stock.
- Process returns in the warehouse system.

Together with your colleagues, you'll ensure every product is handled carefully from the moment it arrives until it leaves the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or part-time.
- You enjoy active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk throughout your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Working hours in aTwo-shift system

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

Approved ROV training, and experience driving an ROV in an operational setting

A technical or electrical education, and practical experience from maintenance and fault-finding on mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems

Experience of leading a small team, or the clear ambition and ability to take that step

The discipline to work by written procedures and checklists, and to get reports out on time

Working proficiency in English, and fitness for physical work at quaysides, on pontoons and on board vessels

You are the senior person on the station and the point of contact for everyone who deals with it  the crew, the vessel, the port and our own management. You plan the cleanings, get the permissions in place, fly the ROV yourself, and make sure the job is reported properly afterwards. When something breaks or the plan changes, you are the one who decides what happens next.
The work is governed by procedures, checklists and manufacturers' manuals, and we operate alongside customers, ports and crews who expect us to do things the same way every time. As supervisor you set the standard for that, and you are responsible for a safe workplace and a clean operation at all times.

Experience in a production environment is an advantage but not required.
You are physically fit and able to perform demanding manual work.
You work accurately and pay attention to detail.
You enjoy working as part of a team.
You are willing to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
You speak either Dutch or English.

Are you a hard worker who enjoys physical work and getting things done? Apply today and join our client's team!
